excerpt: As the enterprise browser market heats up with Island's $4.8B valuation, we compare the key features, benefits, and use cases of Kahana's Oasis and Island Enterprise Browser to help organizations make an informed choice.
content:
The enterprise browser landscape has evolved significantly in 2025, with two major players leading the charge: Island Enterprise Browser and Oasis Browser. Following Island's recent $250M Series E funding and $4.8B valuation, we're taking a deep dive into how these two solutions compare across key dimensions that matter most to enterprises.

Market Overview

The enterprise browser market has seen explosive growth in 2025, driven by several key factors:

  • Rising cybersecurity threats, with browser-based attacks increasing by 70% year-over-year
  • Remote work becoming the norm, with 65% of enterprise employees working remotely at least part-time
  • Increasing regulatory requirements around data protection and privacy
  • Growing demand for integrated security and productivity solutions

Security Architecture

Both browsers excel in security, but with fundamentally different approaches:

Island's Approach

  • Granular Control: Offers detailed policy enforcement at the browser level, with real-time monitoring and adjustment capabilities
  • Integration Focus: Deep integration with existing security tools and SIEM platforms
  • Zero Trust Implementation: Built-in zero trust architecture with continuous verification
  • DLP Capabilities: Advanced data loss prevention with AI-powered content analysis

Oasis's Approach

  • Hub-Based Security: Innovative security model that compartmentalizes work contexts
  • Intelligent Isolation: Smart containerization that balances security with usability
  • Adaptive Policies: Context-aware security policies that adjust based on user behavior and risk levels
  • Proactive Protection: AI-driven threat prevention with predictive analysis

Productivity Features

While both browsers aim to enhance workplace productivity, their approaches differ significantly:

Oasis Innovations

  • Multi-View Capability: Revolutionary split-screen and multi-workspace management
    • Intelligent workspace organization based on user patterns
    • Context-aware tab grouping and management
    • AI-powered workflow optimization
  • Smart Automation:
    • Automated form filling with security checks
    • Intelligent bookmark management
    • Workflow templates for common tasks
  • Collaboration Tools:
    • Built-in secure screen sharing
    • Collaborative browsing sessions
    • Integrated knowledge sharing

Island Features

  • Workflow Optimization:
    • Automated task sequences
    • Policy-based automation
    • Compliance-aware workflows
  • Integration Capabilities:
    • Enterprise tool integration
    • Custom extension support
    • API-driven automation

Technical Architecture

Both browsers build on Chromium, but with distinct architectural choices that reflect their different priorities:

Oasis Architecture

  • Modular Design:
    • Microservices-based architecture for scalability
    • Isolated workspaces with dedicated resources
    • Built-in redundancy for enterprise reliability
    • Edge computing support for improved performance
  • Security Implementation:
    • Kernel-level isolation
    • Hardware-backed security features
    • Custom protocol handlers for enterprise apps

Island Architecture

  • OS Integration:
    • Deep system-level integration
    • Native performance optimization
    • Enhanced security controls
  • Enterprise Features:
    • Centralized management console
    • Policy enforcement engine
    • Audit logging system

Enterprise Benefits

Each browser offers unique advantages for enterprise deployment:

Oasis Enterprise Benefits

  • Workflow Integration:
    • Seamless integration with existing enterprise tools
    • Custom workflow support
    • Advanced automation capabilities
  • Productivity Enhancement:
    • AI-powered workspace organization
    • Intelligent tab management
    • Context-aware automation
  • Deployment Flexibility:
    • Cloud-native architecture
    • Hybrid deployment options
    • Custom deployment models
  • Audit Capabilities:
    • Comprehensive activity logging
    • Advanced analytics
    • Compliance reporting

Island Enterprise Benefits

  • Security Integration:
    • Robust DLP capabilities
    • Zero-trust implementation
    • Advanced threat protection
  • Management Features:
    • Centralized control
    • Policy management
    • User monitoring

User Experience

The user experience differs significantly between the two platforms, reflecting their different approaches to enterprise browsing:

Oasis User Experience

  • Modern Interface:
    • Clean, intuitive design
    • Customizable workspaces
    • Smart navigation features
  • AI Assistance:
    • Intelligent tab suggestions
    • Workflow optimization
    • Context-aware tools

Island User Experience

  • Familiar Design:
    • Chrome-like interface
    • Enterprise controls integration
    • Policy-aware features

Market Position and Future

Both browsers represent the future of enterprise browsing, but with different strategic focuses:

Oasis Strategy

  • Market Position:
    • Productivity-first secure browser
    • Focus on modern workplace needs
    • Innovation in user experience
  • Future Direction:
    • AI-driven feature development
    • Enhanced collaboration tools
    • Advanced automation capabilities

Island Strategy

  • Market Position:
    • Security-first enterprise browser
    • Focus on regulated industries
    • Emphasis on compliance
  • Future Direction:
    • Enhanced security features
    • Deeper enterprise integration
    • Expanded compliance capabilities

Making the Choice

The choice between Oasis and Island ultimately depends on your organization's specific needs and priorities. Consider these key factors:

  • Security Requirements: Both offer robust security, but with different approaches
  • Productivity Needs: Oasis excels in modern workplace productivity features
  • Integration Requirements: Consider compatibility with your existing tools
  • User Experience: Evaluate which approach better suits your workforce
  • Compliance Needs: Assess specific regulatory requirements

While Island brings robust security controls and deep enterprise integration, Oasis offers a compelling blend of security and productivity features that many modern enterprises find invaluable. The recent market movements, including Island's significant funding round, indicate that both solutions will continue to evolve and innovate in this rapidly growing market.
